title: AI-Enhanced Detection and Prediction at Saruq Al-Hadid Archaeological Site, Dubai, UAE
summary: Dubai Culture and Khalifa University report that remote sensing and AI identified known excavation areas and predicted new zones at Saruq Al-Hadid.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Dubai Culture and Khalifa University report that remote sensing and AI identified known excavation areas and predicted new zones at Saruq Al-Hadid. Completed archaeological research pilot. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Guide archaeological investigation through non-invasive mapping and prediction.
developer: Dubai Culture & Arts Authority and Khalifa University
location: Saruq Al-Hadid, Dubai, United Arab Emirates

ratings.reason: The completed pilot reportedly detected known excavation areas, predicted promising zones, and produced a geospatial knowledge base. This supports improved archaeological analysis capability, without proving a new discovery.
Heritage conservation is intended; avoided damage and broader preservation effects are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: Machine-learning segmentation and clustering interpret remote-sensing data to map known and potential archaeological features. Field and geophysical surveys support validation.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: AI-Enhanced Detection and Prediction at Saruq Al-Hadid Archaeological Site, Dubai, UAE

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Field or geophysical validation of predicted archaeological zones

headline: AI maps archaeological potential at Saruq Al-Hadid

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
